tools.title: ChatGPT
tools.description: ChatGPT is a versatile language model (LLM) developed by OpenAI. It can generate human-like text, answer questions, write code, write emails, translate languages, and more. It is available via a web interface and mobile app, offering free and paid subscription plans.

tools.title: Claude
tools.description: Claude, developed by Anthropic, is a family of LLMs known for their sophisticated reasoning, creativity, and nuanced conversation. Claude emphasizes safety, honesty, and helpfulness, and is widely used for creative writing, coding, and complex information processing.

tools.title: Gemini
tools.description: Gemini (formerly Bard) is Google's most capable AI model. Integrated into search and other Google services, Gemini offers multimodal capabilities, including text, image, and video processing. It excels in reasoning, translation, and general-purpose assistance.

tools.title: Perplexity
tools.description: Perplexity is an AI-powered conversational search engine. It provides direct, cited answers to queries by searching the web in real-time. It's often praised for its accuracy and its ability to summarize complex information from multiple sources.

tools.title: DeepSeek
tools.description: DeepSeek is an open-source AI platform specializing in large language models for various tasks, including natural language processing and coding assistance. It offers powerful, efficient models that are often comparable to leading proprietary models.

tools.title: Midjourney
tools.description: Midjourney is a popular AI image generation tool known for its high-quality, artistic, and detailed output. It operates predominantly through a Discord server, where users provide text prompts to generate unique and stunning visual content.

tools.title: Stable Diffusion (Stability AI)
tools.description: Stable Diffusion is an open-source deep learning model for generating images from text. It is highly customizable and can be run locally or on various cloud platforms. It has fostered a massive community of developers and artists.

tools.title: DALL-E 3 (OpenAI)
tools.description: DALL-E 3 is OpenAI's latest image generation model. It is integrated directly into ChatGPT Plus, allowing for precise, high-definition image creation using conversational prompts. It is known for its improved accuracy and detail.

tools.title: Jasper AI
tools.description: Jasper is an AI-powered writing tool designed for marketing teams and content creators. It helps generate copy for blogs, social media, advertisements, and more, offering templates and specialized features for various marketing needs.

tools.title: Copy.ai
tools.description: Copy.ai is an AI writing assistant focused on generating marketing copy and high-quality content. It offers dozens of templates and tools to help with social media posts, email marketing, blog outlines, and more.

tools.title: Otter.ai
tools.description: Otter.ai is an AI-powered transcription and meeting tool. It can record, transcribe, and summarize meetings in real-time. It is widely used for interviews, lectures, and business collaboration.

tools.title: DeepL
tools.description: DeepL is an AI translation tool known for its high accuracy and natural-sounding translations. It supports dozens of languages and offers both free and paid translation services for individuals and businesses.

tools.title: Notion AI
tools.description: Notion AI is an integrated AI writing assistant within the popular Notion productivity platform. It can summarize documents, write drafts, fix grammar, and brainstorm ideas, all within a user's Notion workspace.

tools.title: Mural AI
tools.description: Mural AI is a suite of AI-powered features within the Mural digital whiteboard platform. It helps with brainstorming, summarizing sessions, and generating ideas to enhance collaborative workflows and creative thinking.

tools.title: Synthesia
tools.description: Synthesia is an AI video generation platform that creates professional-looking videos with AI avatars and voice-overs. It is used for corporate training, marketing, and instructional videos, without the need for a camera or microphone.

tools.title: ElevenLabs
tools.description: ElevenLabs is a top-tier AI voice generation tool known for its highly realistic and expressive voice cloning and text-to-speech capabilities. It supports multiple languages and offers high-quality audio output.

tools.title: Gamma
tools.description: Gamma is an AI-powered presentation and document creation tool. It allows users to generate polished decks, pages, and reports from text prompts, offering a faster and more intuitive way to share ideas visually.

tools.title: Framer AI
tools.description: Framer AI is a website builder that uses AI to generate layouts and designs from text prompts. It is part of the Framer design and publishing platform, enabling users to create high-quality websites quickly and easily.

tools.title: Wix ADI
tools.description: Wix ADI (Artificial Design Intelligence) is a tool within the Wix platform that creates professional-looking websites by asking users a few questions. It automatically generates a layout, colors, and content based on user input.

tools.title: Durable
tools.description: Durable is an AI website builder specially designed for small businesses and entrepreneurs. It can generate a fully functional business website, including copy and images, in less than a minute based on very little information.

tools.title: v0.dev
tools.description: v0.dev, by Vercel, is an AI-powered UI generation tool that creates React and Tailwind CSS components based on text prompts. It is designed to speed up the front-end development process and provide high-quality building blocks.

tools.title: Replit Agent
tools.description: Replit Agent is an AI assistant within the Replit online IDE that helps with coding, debugging, and project management. It can generate code, answer questions, and even manage environment setup and deployment.

tools.title: Tabnine
tools.description: Tabnine is an AI-powered code completion tool that supports multiple programming languages and popular code editors. It learns from a developer's code and suggests personalized additions to speed up coding.

tools.title: Cursor
tools.description: Cursor is a fork of VS Code, an AI-powered code editor with deep integration of LLMs. It offers powerful code generation, editing, and debugging features directly within the editor environment.

tools.title: Bolt.new
tools.description: A browser-based AI code editor and platform for rapid application building and deployment, often associated with StackBlitz and modern web development workflows.

tools.title: Lovable.dev
tools.description: An AI platform designed to make development more accessible and 'lovable,' potentially focusing on no-code or low-code solutions powered by high-level AI reasoning.

tools.title: Canva Magic Studio
tools.description: A comprehensive suite of AI features within the Canva design platform, including text-to-image, background removal, and an AI-powered writing assistant.

tools.title: Loom AI
tools.description: AI-powered features within the Loom video messaging platform that automatically generate titles, summaries, and action items from recordings.

tools.title: Descript
tools.description: An AI-powered video and audio editor that allows users to edit recordings by editing text transcripts. It offers features like voice cloning and overdubbing.

tools.title: Soundraw
tools.description: AI-based music creation platform. $11.05/month to $32.50/month. At least $19.05/month to monitize your music.

tools.title: Krea
tools.description: AI Chat, Image Generator, etc

tools.title: SkyReels V1
tools.description: Text to Video, Image to Video

tools.title: Sonauto
tools.description: Text to Audio, Inpaint, etc

tools.title: Riffusion
tools.description: Text to Audio

tools.title: Playground AI
tools.description: Text to Image

tools.title: Sesami AI
tools.description: Conversational AI Voice Chat

tools.title: Grammarly
tools.description: AI-powered writing assistant that helps with grammar checking, spell checking, and style improvements. Free basic plan; premium plans start at $12/month.

tools.title: Wordtune
tools.description: AI writing companion that helps rewrite and rephrase sentences to improve clarity and style. Free plan available; premium plans start at $9.99/month.

tools.title: Rytr
tools.description: AI writing assistant that helps create content like blogs, emails, and more. Free plan available; premium plans start at $9/month.

tools.title: Sudowrite
tools.description: AI creative writing assistant designed to help writers with ideas, descriptions, and more. Plans start at $10/month.

tools.title: GPT-o1 (OpenAI)
tools.description: OpenAI's series of reasoning models trained with reinforcement learning to perform complex tasks and solve harder problems than previous models in science, coding, and math.

tools.title: Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic)
tools.description: Anthropic's 3.5 model family, offering high speed and state-of-the-art reasoning, particularly excelling in coding, visual reasoning, and nuanced text generation.

tools.title: Gemini 1.5 Pro (Google)
tools.description: Google's powerful multimodal model with an extensive context window (up to 2 million tokens), enabling the processing of massive amounts of information like long documents, hours of video, or large codebases.

tools.title: Apple Intelligence
tools.description: Apple's personal intelligence system integrated into iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, combining generative models with personal context to deliver useful and relevant intelligence while protecting privacy.
